value.rationale: The fixed-symmetry-axis rectangle capacity is a natural precise packing invariant for the classical constant-width rotor. Its non-obvious off-center and nonsquare optimum and exact contact pattern give a reproducible benchmark and lower bound for unrestricted rectangle capacity, rather than an arbitrary parameter substitution.
